# ML-10: Recommender and Ranking Systems (Tier 3)

**Subtrack:** Machine Learning Engineering  
**Unit scope:** Collaborative filtering, matrix factorisation, implicit feedback, ranking metrics and offline evaluation pitfalls.

**Tier note:** Tier 1 has one assessment. Recommenders need supervised-learning and evaluation fluency first, so most of the unit's depth sits at Tiers 2 and 3.

## Assessments

Pick **any one**. Every assessment here is an independent, complete demonstration of this unit at this tier.

| [`ML-T3-019`](ML-T3-019-position-bias-in-the-market-feed/README.md) | Position Bias in the Market Feed: Learning to Rank from Clicks Without Learning Where We Put Things | Open-Ended | e-commerce, marketplaces, ranking | 24–34 h | CPU, offline-capable | T3 M4 R4 E3 A5 R1 |

- **[ML-T3-019](ML-T3-019-position-bias-in-the-market-feed/README.md): Position Bias in the Market Feed: Learning to Rank from Clicks Without Learning Where We Put Things.** Learn a ranker from position-biased marketplace click logs: estimate the examination curve from a small randomised slice, build an inverse-propensity estimator for policies that were never run, train a debiased ranker, and analyse the cost and benefit of exposing small vendors.
